mentions.name: Orchid journaling app
mentions.description: This app is an orchid journaling tool that lets users create profiles for each of their orchids, give the flowers names, and track their daily statistics, similar to baby-tracking apps but for orchids. It is built with Flutter for cross-platform support, with the Android version currently in use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just made a orchid journaling app. It lets you create profiles of all your orchids, give the flowers name and track their daily statistics. Kind of like those baby tracking apps for new parents, but all about orchid flowers instead.
